name: travel-hacking-toolkit
title_zh: 用现金、积分、里程和奖励机票组合出最优旅行方案
tagline_zh: 别在十几个订票网站间来回切换了。一个工具箱同时搜现金价、积分价、里程票和奖励舱位，直接比出哪个组合最划算。
tagline_en: Stop tab-hopping across booking sites. One toolkit searches cash, points, miles, and award fares side-by-side to.
desc_en: AI-powered travel hacking and search with cash, points, miles, and award flights. Drop-in skills and MCP servers for Cla
why_zh: 不是又一个比价器，而是把四种支付逻辑（现金/积分/里程/奖励票）揉进同一套搜索里，能交叉算组合。
why_en: Not another price comparator—it fuses four payment logics (cash/points/miles/awards) into one search, so you can evaluate.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

limit_zh: 只覆盖机票搜索与组合比价，不含酒店、租车或行程规划。需要你已有至少一个航司或银行积分账户；纯现金用户只能用到一半功能。
limit_en: Flights only—no hotels, car rentals, or itineraries. Requires at least one airline/bank points account; cash-only users get half the value. No live.
